name: The Fargodeep Mine
summary: South of Goldshire, Marshal Dughan sends you to scout the kobold-held Fargodeep Mine. It lies between the Stonefield and Maclure farms, and its fall points to trouble beyond its tunnels.

sections.title: Trouble South of Goldshire
sections.body: Kobolds have taken the Fargodeep Mine south of Goldshire, between the feuding Stonefield and Maclure homesteads. It once supplied stone and ore for the realm. Now shrill chattering echoes through its damp tunnels, where tallow candles burn. Marshal Dughan sends you to scout the depths and learn how bad the trouble is.

sections.title: A Strained Guard
sections.body: When Dughan hears your report, he worries about other mineral sites, including the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast. The news adds to the Stormwind Guard's strain. Its troops are already stretched thin defending against Defias bandits and gnoll incursions, leaving too few to clear the tunnels.

faq.q: Where is the Fargodeep Mine located?
faq.answer: The Fargodeep Mine lies almost due south of Goldshire in Elwynn Forest, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.

faq.q: Who sends you to scout the Fargodeep Mine?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan, the Stormwind Guard's commanding officer in Goldshire, sends you to scout the tunnels.

faq.q: What creatures have taken over the mine?
faq.answer: Kobolds have overrun the mine, lit their candles, and driven out the human workers.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Dughan need adventurers to check the mine?
faq.answer: The Stormwind Guard is stretched thin by local banditry, orc remnants, and gnoll raids, leaving Dughan without spare soldiers even to confirm scout reports.

faq.q: What happens after scouting the Fargodeep Mine?
faq.answer: After you report the trouble to Marshal Dughan, he fears it is widespread and sends you northeast to investigate the Jasperlode Mine.

faq.q: Why is the infestation of Fargodeep Mine significant?
faq.answer: The fall of the Fargodeep Mine shows that the kobold infestation in Northshire was not isolated. Wild threats are pressing rapidly into settled farmland just outside Stormwind's gates.

angles.text: As a miner, you can find rich copper veins inside the Fargodeep Mine, though territorial kobolds stand in your way.
As an Alliance member, you see the overrun mine as another sign that Stormwind struggles to protect Elwynn's essential sites.
